reviews.text: I visited Dr. Ikemura for treatment of Louis, a medium-sized dog with allergic skin disease. Not only did Dr. Ikemura examine Louis carefully and thoroughly, but he also made an appointment with a specialist dermatology hospital, contacting them multiple times to arrange a second-line consultation. Dr. Ikemura is a truly kind and wonderful doctor who cares deeply about animals, and he went to great lengths to help Louis because he felt sorry for him as his itching would get worse if left untreated. Thank you so much as always! We look forward to your continued support!

They always put the animals first. They're a veterinarian who not only provides immediate care but also watches over the cat's growth, making them a veterinarian you can have a long-term relationship with.

I recently got a cat and came here to ask for advice on finding a vet. The director's wife (I think?) asked me where I bought the cat, and when I told her the name of the pet shop, she started saying things like that shop wasn't good, and that the cat wouldn't live long because it had a fungal infection at such a young age because of the poor environment. She was just trying to stir up my anxiety. I don't know if she felt the need to say whatever she thought, but she was very unpleasant, and I decided I wouldn't go back there. She seemed like a person with no tact whatsoever.
Doctor is super kind and I can see he care about animals. The nurse, receptionist are also very nice. Great pet clinic.

I use this pet clinic for health checkups, vaccinations, and pet boarding for my rescued cats (a brother and sister), and I trust them completely. For difficult cases, they refer me to hospitals with specialists. They've been in business for over half a century and are relied upon by the local community!

This veterinary clinic in Setagaya Ward accepts the cat neutering subsidy, but their neutering surgery fees were several times higher than other clinics. It's extremely shady and I cannot recommend it.

They kindly accepted my urgent request for an appointment and saw my dog ​​immediately upon arrival. Both the nurses and the doctor were incredibly kind, and their attentive care to both my dog ​​and me warmed my heart. My dog ​​seemed very comfortable there. I would definitely like to bring my dog ​​back to this hospital if needed. I highly recommend it!
